verdict.rationale: You can build custom risk rules, grouped into risk profiles, that are evaluated on every transaction and automatically block, allow, or send it to review (adyen-risk-docs-6, -4, -1, -9). Dynamic 3D Secure rules decide routing and challenges, rule triggers are reported in webhooks and payment responses, and rules can be backtested before going live (adyen-risk-docs-10, -16, -19). Missing for 10: actions are limited to risk decisions on payment events rather than general event-to-action automation, there is no evidence of defining rules programmatically via API or MCP, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
